transcript.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
Sorry — I couldn't start making your ClearDay ad. My access to the Magic Hour tools was blocked when I tried to use them, so nothing was made and no credits were spent. Please try again in a moment.
transcript.why: The reply says it could not start the ClearDay ad because its access to the Magic Hour tools was blocked. It made nothing and spent no credits. It asks the user to retry later. It does not ask a question, request approval, deliver a result, or decline on policy grounds. The tools it needs are unavailable, which matches "cannot".

transcript.text: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

Your ClearDay ad is ready:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/5f3e8dc3ce2d4da4bd8c9c94f9613eb6.mp4

What it contains:
- 0–6 s: a demo app screen I made up, in white with soft blue accents. A cluttered to-do list sorts itself into a tidy plan with morning, afternoon and evening blocks, while the camera slowly pushes in.
- 6–8 s: an end card on calm blue with "ClearDay" and the tagline "Your day, made simple." I picked the tagline because you left the other wording to me.
- 16:9, about 8 seconds (measured 8.1 s), no sound.

What I checked:
- Length, shape and silence were measured and are correct.
- The end card is drawn by code rather than generated, so its words come out exactly as written.
- I can't watch videos, so I haven't seen the 6-second animated part. It's generated from a text description, so the list items are just shapes, not readable words. The way it moves may also differ from what I described.

It's 480p because of the free plan and cost 144 credits. If the animation isn't what you pictured, I can make it again with a different description.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished ad with a video link and a description of its contents. It includes caveats (unverified animation, 480p on the free plan, 144 credits spent) but does not ask a question, request approval, refuse, or say the task cannot be done.
